quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): on strong sales of CMP products for advanced semiconductors and polishing materials for silicon wafers, net sales were JPY 69,404 million (+11.0% YoY), operating profit JPY 13,826 million (+17.4%) and ordinary profit JPY 14,169 million (+15.7%), all record highs; profit attributable to owners of parent fell to JPY 9,059 million (-3.9%) after JPY 1,215 million of prior-year corporate taxes covering several years were booked following findings of a Nagoya Regional Taxation Bureau tax audit. Segments: Japan sales JPY 39,450 million (+11.2%; higher CMP and silicon-wafer product sales), segment profit JPY 11,401 million (+17.3%); North America sales JPY 7,967 million (-2.9%; CMP sales rose but lapping materials for small-diameter silicon wafers fell), segment profit JPY 335 million (+22.1%) on better mix and lower costs; Asia sales JPY 19,599 million (+17.0%; CMP products for advanced logic rose while hard-disk substrate products fell), segment profit JPY 5,252 million (+11.6%) despite higher forward-looking expenses including headcount; Europe sales JPY 2,387 million (+14.5%), segment profit JPY 162 million (+6.1%).
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 69,404 million (+11.0%); operating profit JPY 13,826 million (+17.4%)

Sales by end-customer location: Japan JPY 15,293 million, North America JPY 5,553 million, Asia JPY 45,680 million (of which Taiwan JPY 17,959 million, Korea JPY 9,845 million, China JPY 11,871 million), Europe JPY 2,877 million.

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure and new plant (annual securities report): capex in the year to March 2026 was JPY 24,931 million (171.8% of the prior year) - Japan JPY 22,746 million, North America JPY 528 million, Asia JPY 1,652 million, Europe JPY 6 million - mainly manufacturing buildings in Japan. The Kakamiyama plant (abrasives manufacturing facility, Kakamigahara, Gifu) was newly established in February 2026; its book value at March 31, 2026 was JPY 25,182 million (buildings and structures JPY 19,188 million). The parent's main additions in the year were buildings at the Kakamiyama plant and others (JPY 18,564 million) and construction in progress at the R&D center and others (JPY 4,880 million). Plan: the group plans JPY 16,233 million of capex in the year to March 2027, including the cost of building a new research laboratory in Japan; no significant disposals are planned beyond routine replacement.

quarterly_data.signal: Medium- to long-term plan (annual securities report): the plan published May 10, 2023 covers the six years to March 2029; its basic policy is to grow the existing semiconductor-related businesses, create new businesses and evolve from an abrasives maker into a 'powder and surface company', with priorities including a resilient base for the semiconductor business and a dominant position in materials for next-generation semiconductors. Management states the year to March 2026 fell short of the plan's 2023 targets: consolidated net sales JPY 694 hundred million vs a plan of JPY 770 hundred million, EBITDA margin 23.3% vs 26.0%, ROE 11.3% vs 15.0%, and non-semiconductor share of sales 16.6% vs 20.0% because adoption of products under development took time. Management states that, as many silicon-wafer and device-maker customers make large capital investments for expected strong semiconductor demand, its challenges are to build a system for phased capex in Japan and overseas, raise R&D and quality-assurance levels, strengthen business continuity and secure stable raw-material supply; priority issues for the year to March 2027 include strengthening supply-chain management and reliably capturing business opportunities.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 vs plan: EBITDA margin 23.3% vs 26.0%; ROE 11.3% vs 15.0%; non-semiconductor share 16.6% vs 20.0%

quarterly_data.signal: Business and market view (annual securities report): management states the semiconductor market is led by demand for advanced semiconductor devices for AI, with PC, smartphone and automotive demand showing signs of bottoming, but the downside risk from tight supply and soaring prices of commodity memory needs continued watching; it expects further medium- to long-term growth. The company claims the world's number-one market share in ultra-precision polishing materials for semiconductor substrates. Silicon business: polishing materials from slicing to final polishing for silicon wafers; it is developing products for SiC substrates and producing them at its US and Malaysian sites. CMP business: the films and process steps to which CMP is applied are increasing with higher device performance, density and integration, and CMP is also applied in 3D device-stacking technologies now in development and mass production; CMP manufacturing and development bases are in Japan, the US and Taiwan, close to customers. Disk business: manufacturing in Malaysia; management expects data-center hard-disk demand to stay high as AI raises the need for large-capacity storage. Other businesses: thermal-spray materials (for semiconductor equipment, aircraft and steel), polishing solutions (e.g. automotive exterior polishing compounds) and advanced functional powders (high-thermal-conductivity ceramic powders, ceramic composites, cemented-carbide materials for 3D printers).

R&D, year to March 2026 (annual securities report): R&D expenses JPY 5,835 million (Japan JPY 4,271 million, North America JPY 1,038 million, Asia JPY 525 million); Japan develops all products, North America and Asia develop CMP products. CMP: as device integration advances, demand is growing for polishing products including those for making new-structure transistors; the company is developing products for further scaling in the next generation, and some new products are being evaluated by major customers for adoption. Silicon wafers: final-polishing materials that reduce ultra-small defects while giving a smoother surface have been adopted by major customers, and new-concept primary / secondary polishing materials by many customers. Polishing materials for hard-to-process SiC and GaN substrates for power devices: new high-speed, high-surface-quality products and processes under development. Hard disks: a high-performance next-generation polishing material for aluminum disks, developed against intensifying competition, is under customer evaluation.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 5,835 million (Japan JPY 4,271 million; North America JPY 1,038 million)
